bagPolicy.summary: Official venue guidance applies a clear-bag policy with a stated maximum size of 12 x 12 x 6 inches.
allowed: Clear bag up to 12 x 12 x 6 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Nearby options include valet, surface lots, and street parking. The theater does not manage these facilities.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Buckhead Theatre. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Official venue guidance says food and beverage concessions are available.

accessibility.summary: The main entrance and bathrooms are accessible. An elevator reaches the balcony and lounge. Tell staff about accessibility needs on arrival.
